title: Impact walks only to dependents, so downstream consumers of changed code are never listed
evidence: The graph at the introducer has parseClipboard -> parsePotentialSpreadsheet -> tryParseSpreadsheet (CALLS), and parseClipboard is a changed entity. buildImpact walks reverse edges only, so the consumer is in no blast radius.
possibleFixes: Walk 2 to 3 steps forward from changed entities and label the result as a separate tier
Add value-flow edges (output of A reaches input of B) to limit the forward walk to code that receives the changed value
Send the consumer's code to the report so it can see assumptions such as split("\t")
pinnedBy: packages/analyzer/test/known-gaps.test.ts :: GAP-001 a consumer downstream of a changed function is not in the impact

title: The report gets no features for a change when the context is file-level and the repo has no surfaces
evidence: Rebuilt payload for excalidraw-11: features is empty on the clipboard changes, although feature charts-and-paste lists src/clipboard.ts in files. buildContextPack links features only through annotations and surfaces (context-pack.ts:149-152); this context has 0 annotations and 0 surfaces, and feature.files is never read. Contributing cause only: fixing it does not prove the report would then name chart paste.
possibleFixes: Link features through feature.files for the changed file, as rules already do through rule.files
pinnedBy: packages/reporting/test/known-gaps.test.ts :: GAP-002 a feature that lists the changed file is not linked to the change

title: The report describes a changed behavior as intended and does not ask what relied on the old behavior
evidence: The QA report for excalidraw-11 tells QA to verify that tabs display as eight spaces and never names spreadsheet or chart paste. The payload did hold pointers: the clipboard.ts role mentions spreadsheet data, the parseClipboard diff shows parsePotentialSpreadsheet, and charts.ts and PasteChartDialog are listed as dependents of normalizeText. One run of openai/gpt-6-luna, so variance is unknown.
possibleFixes: Add a report instruction: for each removed guarantee, name what could have relied on it
Repeat the report on several runs to measure how often it names the consumer
pinExempt: LLM output is not deterministic, so a unit test cannot pin it. Track it by re-running the report on the corpus.
